headline: Toyota Reports Profit Growth and Raises Annual Outlook
summary: Toyota Motor Corporation reported its first profit increase in six quarters and raised its annual earnings guidance.
why: Toyota is one of the world's largest automakers; its financial performance and guidance are key indicators for the global automotive sector and supply chain health.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor
impacts.why: Profit growth and raised guidance are positive indicators for shareholders.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The positive earnings surprise and improved outlook typically lead to increased investor confidence and upward pressure on the company's stock price.
